title: Compact-support projection from exact strict transports
statement:
theorem nonempty_strictEtaleTransportProjection_of_equivalences
    {O O' : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing O] [CommRing O'] {ell : O} {mu : O'}
    {phi : O →+* O'} {index : ℕ →o ℕ}
    (a : StrictEtaleCoefficientChange O O' ell mu phi index)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y} (c : Compactification f)
    (SA : StrictEtaleCompactSupport O ell c) (SB : StrictEtaleCompactSupport O' mu c)
    (TX : StrictEtaleCoefficientTransport a X SA.PX SB.PX)
    (TY : StrictEtaleCoefficientTransport a Y SA.PY SB.PY)
    (TZ : StrictEtaleCoefficientTransport a c.Z SA.PZ SB.PZ)
    (_hTX : ∀ n, (TX.level n).derived.IsEquivalence)
    (_hTY : ∀ n, (TY.level n).derived.IsEquivalence)
    (_hTZ : ∀ n, (TZ.level n).derived.IsEquivalence) :
    Nonempty (StrictEtaleTransportProjection a c SA SB TX TY TZ)

source.place: Construction 4.1, Construction 5.15 and Lemma 5.22 (printed pp. 21, 35–36); geometric restriction part of the parent cofinal step, generalized to any monotone selection with isomorphic selected rings. The compact-support presentations already include their evaluated derived direct images.

proof.text: Transpose the tensor-unit coefficient squares along the open and proper adjunctions, then compose their mates. The normalized quotient tensor interchange gives the evaluation and quotient cubes.

proof_origin.place: Extraction of geometric left-adjoint projection construction from the parent cofinal argument. Arithmetic ideal equality and exceptional mate assembly are proved in the parent Lean module.
